description: A compatibility-preserving diagnostic adapter for Self-EvolveRec that inspects the actual trained recommender using observable training data. It retains DiagnosisProbe(view, device) and run_full_diagnosis(train_loader), returning metrics and metric_definitions. Model selection uses macro-average validation HR@10 across all four Amazon categories.
motivation: Keep diagnostics valid as the recommender architecture evolves, while preventing fabricated metadata, unobserved simulator traits, or hidden test information from influencing search.
implementation_notes: Access the trained network through view.model and adapt probes to its architecture. Preserve the compatibility interfaces item_emb, log2feats, predict_score, user_train, meta_data, and review_data. Training batches contain (None, sequence, positive, negative), with tensors shaped B × L. Mask padding, compute diagnostics without updating parameters, and restore the model's prior training mode afterward. Use only interaction histories, titles, descriptions, and timestamps; unavailable fields must remain unavailable. Provide full-catalog unseen-item recommendations to twenty real training users, five per category. Retain dataset routing, fixed splits and seeds, and the pinned evaluator. Any architecture change must also update the predictor writer.
pseudocode:
class DiagnosisProbe(view, device):
    run_full_diagnosis(train_loader):
        save model training mode
        set view.model to evaluation mode
        initialize metrics and metric_definitions
        without gradients:
            for _, sequence, positive, negative in train_loader:
                move tensors to device
                mask padding and invalid targets
                compute features through the adapted view
                compute supported diagnostics from actual model outputs
                aggregate with explicit valid-example counts
            compute supported history and embedding diagnostics
        restore prior model training mode
        return metrics, metric_definitions

Separately, generate full-catalog unseen-item recommendations for the designated training users. Select trials using the host's macro validation HR@10 across all four categories.

originality.positive: Makes diagnostic compatibility and evidence boundaries explicit within an evolving recommendation pipeline.
originality.negative: Primarily an integration contract; it does not introduce a new recommendation algorithm or diagnostic estimator.

future_potential.positive: Can support consistent diagnosis across architectures and guide targeted model changes.
future_potential.negative: The description does not establish that its diagnostics predict validation improvements.

code_difficulty.positive: A fixed entry point, batch format, and compatibility interface make the initial implementation manageable.
code_difficulty.negative: Architecture changes require careful adaptation of feature extraction, scoring, masking, aggregation, and predictor serialization.
